description: Strings set and copied in a localized Starfield plugin: SFBGS004.esm loaded under another name (OracleLoc.esm), so it is not an official module, which Starfield does not let be edited; two names changed in place (Put), a misc item of Starfield.esm copied as an override and as a new record (its localized strings assigned as text, so they become new strings of the plugin's tables).
